title: request-filtering-agent before 3.2.2 contains a server-side request forgery filter bypass because address validation…
description: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) filter bypass exists in request-filtering-agent versions before 3.2.2. The vulnerability arises because the address validation logic incorrectly treats IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses in the ::/96 range as public unicast addresses. This allows attackers controlling a fetched URL to use specially crafted IPv6 addresses to access internal loopback or link-local services, including sensitive cloud metadata endpoints.
